newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases in cool session.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases in cool session.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased in a cool trading session on Monday, bourse officials said.
The index lost 7.68 points to close at 3447.90. Turnover was posted at 18.6 million shillings traded on 618,843 shares compared to 13 million shillings traded on 300,467 shares on Friday.
"There's been a lot of foreign buying, and very little local to local trading, but the market is rather cool," said a broker.
Kenya Airways ended the day the most traded share with 324,650 sold, closing unchanged on eight shillings.
Kenya Commercial Bank closed at 103 from 105, while National Industrial Credit was unchanged at 60. Uchumi Supermarket lost 1.7 shillings to close at 37.30.

Rea Vipingo Plantations edged up 40 cents to close at 8.15. Sasini Tea and Coffee was unchanged at 80. Carbacid Investments lost three shillings to close at 80 shillings while Kenya Power and Lighting closed at 175 from 173.
The fourth issue of the Central Bank of Kenya floating-rate treasury bond traded 150,000 shillings at 101.89 percent from 101.8934 percent.
